name: Texas Oncology
identity_check: The fund-list row 'Texas Oncology Fund II, $62M, 2026-04-22, Dallas' is a mislabel. The $62M Fund II closed in April 2026 belongs to Oncology Ventures, an Austin, Texas venture firm (founder and managing partner Ben Freeberg), per Pulse 2.0's reprint of the release; Texas Oncology is only its anchor investor/limited partner. Texas Oncology itself is a physician-led oncology practice (550+ physicians, 300 locations), a healthcare provider, not a venture investor. Not recorded as an investor; Oncology Ventures should get its own queue entry. No Dallas fund of that size was found.
